posts.text:
my upcoming book about panicking parents, youth sports, schools, safetyism, and technology now has a page and a cover.

The book is a confession/convo about being a crazy sports dad, myself, and how parenting got so intensely privatized. 

penguinrandomhouse.com/books…

some topics discussed: public school curricula, the pandemic, pick up and drop off circles, Kumon, and much more. Please pre-order the book. Will keep you all updated as we get towards publication day.

I wrote the book as a coming together of frustrated parents in a Chautauqua-styled conversation to talk about what is great about parenting (like watching your kid compete and score goals) and how we can get back to a sane, healthy version of that.

Not saying Kobe means he’s not serious about winning


Tom Steyer (@TomSteyer)

Going into the next few days, I’m channeling the greats.

Vote by June 2nd — we're all on Team California.

— https://nitter.net/TomSteyer/status/2061201050443677808#m
If Bron in year 3 had the spurs supporting cast how many titles does he win in Cleveland… four minimum?
Still not quite over Keldon Johnson last night where every shot was ‘are you sure’ and they kept going in.
Really a terrible finals for haters tbh. Gonna have to dig deep for this one. Would love for KAT to win, would be happy for (most) Knicks fans, love Stephon Castle like he’s part of my family…
ALL THE THUNDER FANS TALKING SHIT TO ME ALL WEEK HOLD THAT
Chet sitting at the end of this… is he better than Luke kornet
Shai played a great first half and back to flopping everywhere. Glad he didn’t fold to the online pressure
Fox has to shoot that pull up midrange shot.
thank you Raya for bailing him out
Oh no I love eze but that was textbook PK nonsense karma
All press and four centerbacks seems to be working
Alright let’s split. Arsenal beats the French and the French win tonight. Deal?
